scope: G19 Gold Completion Bridge / Method-Depth Resolution
decision_detail: Canonical full-softmax SASRec trained to CONVERGENCE is the necessary run (closest competitor was still improving at stop). LightGCN is optional/strongly-desirable (graph-family closure). No new models run in this gate.
blocking_section: Template §9 Technique Tournament (method depth) — canonical SASRec not trained to convergence; LightGCN deferred

why_senior: full-softmax confound controlled (6.7x lift, still < ALS)
found the real lever: candidate coverage (G13 +44%)
why_not_terminal: canonical full-softmax SASRec loss still descending at 40 ep (R@20 0.0456)
method_depth_argument.reason: Cannot assert MF wins TERMINALLY while the nearest competitor was provably mid-descent; doing so would loosen the claim boundary.

blocks_gold_items: Technique tournament: canonical-SASRec convergence (+ optional LightGCN)

achievement_moments: Deep models attractive but ALS won (honest negative)
Feature importance high but marginal contribution ~zero (ablation)
Candidate coverage not ranking was the bottleneck (G13 +44%)
Slate governance sophisticated but upstream candidates the better lever (pure LTR default)
FAISS scoped as latency not quality (recall retention measured)

required_run_spec.model: canonical full-softmax SASRec d64/2blk/2head over 40k vocab
required_run_spec.action: resume ckpt_canonical.pt, train to loss plateau, re-eval 5k LLO vs ALS f64

preregistered_outcomes.still_below_ALS: MF win becomes TERMINAL -> eligible for gold_complete
preregistered_outcomes.contends_or_beats_ALS: advanced model moves the floor -> also gold-eligible (different honest result)

final_recommendation: Remain gold_candidate. One bounded honest run (canonical SASRec to convergence; LightGCN optional) closes the only blocking section and makes the 'MF wins' finding terminal -> then gold_complete is defensible. Do not declare gold_complete via documentation alone.
